verses.al-hamdu-llhi-hadha-sh-shaykhu-rabbahu-c: l-ḥamdu lil-hi hadhā sh-shaykhu rabbāhu khayru l-wujūdi lladhī ʾaʿlahu mawlahu
rabbā bilā khalwati ʾaṣḥābahu ʿalanā ḥattā staqāmū fayā llāhi manḥāhu
bihhimahi ʾaw biḥāli ḥāza tarbiyata niʿma l-murabbī muribbu l-ḥaqqi yarḍāhu
yasqī l-murīdīna min kaʾasi l-wuṣūli ʾilā naḥwi l-murādi lladhī qad kāna maʾawāhu
nāla l-khilāfata qad shāʿat wirāthatuhu ʾatāhu khatmu mina r-raḥmāni wal-jāhu
lahu ḍamānu mina l-mukhtāri mushtamilā bishīʿati ḥāzahā yarḍā bimasʿāhu
fala yumāthiluhu baḥru lahu madadu ṣāḥi wala l-jawdu ḥaqqā min sakhāyāhu
walaw ḥawā jūdahu l-maʿhūda fī ṭalabi baḥru lʾawʿaba durrā min ʿaṭāyāhu
ʾaw ʾashbaha l-wablu fī l-ʾāfāqi munhamirā laʾaṣbaḥa n-nāsu gharqā fīhi jadwāhu
mādhā tarā min rijāli llāhi kullihmu wahwa l-mumiddu bihim wan-nūru yaghshāhu
lil-hi qad ẓahara l-ḥaqqu l-mubīnu lanā la yufliḥu l-muddaʿī ḥubbī bidaʿwāhu
kullu sh-shuyūkhi faqawlu l-ḥaqqi munfaridā min ḥaḍrati l-ghaybi ʾinna r-rabba ʾaʿlahu
ʾimḍāʾuhu kāna yamḍī fī taṣarrufihi fī kulli ʾamri badā ṭūbāhu ṭūbāhu
fī kulli quṭri mina l-ʾaqṭāri shuhratuhu ʿammat mazāyāhu bal dārat zawāhu
hadhā lladhī manaḥa l-ʾaʿlāqa tamdaḥuhu mina l-barāyā ʿajība l-madḥi ʾafwāhu
fahhayinu layyinu khalqa wafī khuluqi lahu mahābatu ṣidqi fī muḥayyāhu
yā sālika sunana l-qarmi lladhī sharufat bihi l-ʾaḥibbahu wal-ʾakhdānu manwāhu
faqul liman fī qiyāsi sh-shaykh mujtahidā qad ʿazza ʾidrāku mā yaḥwīhi maʿnāhu
maʿnāhu baḥru falaysa l-ʿaqalu yudriku mā warāʾa ṭawri l-ḥijā law kāna yahwāhu
lazim lawāzimahu takfī liṭālibihā mina l-manāfiʿi fī d-dunyā waʾukhrāhu
ʾakrim bihi karamā yā ʾakrama l-kuramā yā ʿaylama l-ʿulamā min ṭībi maʿnāhu
hadhā ʿubayduka ʿinda l-bābi yaqraʿuhu walaysa yaʿlamu ʾila ʾanta manḥāhu
ʾinna l-muʿallā laʾaʿlā fī l-mayāsiri qis mā jāʾanā qadaru bihi waʾafshāhu
thumma ṣ-ṣalatu wataslīmu l-ʾilahi ʿalā khayri l-bariyyati ḥaqqā maʿ taḥāyyāhu
wāʾālihi waʿalā ʾaṣḥābihi l-fuḍalā ʾahli n-nuhā wallāhā wal-kullu yaghshāhu
rid wirdahu l-ʿadhba lā taḍjar bidhā ʾabdaa ʾinna l-manāhila tahmī min mazāyāhu
